name: Gerald
source:
Gerald is the man who took you into Borujano and is like an older brother to you. He’s great at looking after people and has a good-natured personality. On the other hand, he will also cruelly and mercilessly punish those he considers an enemy. He doesn’t know his own heritage. He is skilled enough in martial arts to kill someone with his bare hands. The leaders of Borujano place a lot of trust in him. He is always smoking a cigarette.

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.mafiakaigai]Google Play[/url]]
